classification: multi-dimension 10-leg factor library expansion; no promotion

design.purpose: Test whether a broader, economically diversified factor library beats the compact 4/6-leg core under the same walk-forward protocol.
design.selection: For each economic family choose one representative by deterministic registration order; the resulting set is hard-capped at 8 members because factor_rank_research supports at most 8 factors.
design.weights: equal inside the final set, no leverage

known_limits: PB/ROE/gross margin/accrual/debt are local financial snapshot factors with PIT limitations.
Current HS300 membership applied to history retains survivorship bias.
This is a registered-factor combination, not a new formula.
The test window has been observed in prior work.
BUG-R402-01: factor_rank_research supports at most 8 factors; a true 10+ leg library requires a different composition layer.
